messages:
jordan (support): FYI we have an escalation from a customer running our tool-calling evals in their CI — several flaky failures across runs. see snippets below. they see a mix of 401/403 auth errors, 429 billing/rate limits, and 422-like schema validation errors. can eng help triage?

omar (eng-ml): can you paste the failing request/response payloads? are these happening only in CI or reproducible locally with the golden prompts?

jordan (support): pasted logs from the failing CI job:

ci-bot: [CI job build/8427] https://ci.example.com/build/8427 - failed tests: toolcall-regression-suite

jordan (support): ```
Request: POST /v1/call_tool
Headers: Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY
Body: {
  "tool": "search_db",
  "args": {"query": "recent orders", "count": "10"} 
}

Response: 422 Unprocessable Entity
{
  "error": "schema_validation",
  "details": "path args.count: expected integer but got string
}
```

maya (eng): that schema mismatch is the immediate failure, but the auth errors look separate. two things to investigate: 1) the eval harness sometimes mutates types when serializing prompts (we recently added a flatten step), 2) ops mentioned a key rotation earlier today which could explain the 401/403.

omar (eng-ml): reproduced the 422 locally using the golden prompt file (golden_prompt_v3.json) + the eval harness with default arg shims. running the same payload without the flatten step returns integer for count. suspect the harness test-generator coerces numeric args into strings for some prompt templates.

ryan (devex): CI flakiness note: we've also seen intermittent 429s from billing quota hits during parallel CI runs. Those lead to cascade failures because the test runner treats non-200 as hard failure. we should make the eval runner retry idempotent calls with exponential backoff and mark non-deterministic runs as flaky instead of hard failing.

ops-bot: Vault rotation complete at 1798765400 UTC. A subset of long-lived tokens may be invalidated until reissued.

jordan (support): ops-bot confirms vault rotation — that explains 401/403. Customer CI uses a cached token in their self-hosted runner image.

maya (eng): proposed short-term mitigations:
- update eval harness to coerce numeric-like strings back to numbers for specific tool schemas (defensive parsing)
- add a shallow schema sanity check before calling the runtime to catch obvious type mismatches and surface a clearer error in CI logs
- add retries (with jitter) for 429/5xx in the CI runner and treat as transient

omar (eng-ml): long-term: add a test that fuzzes arg types against our tool schemas (schema_test_suite/toolcall_fuzz) and run it in nightly to catch regressions caused by serialization changes or prompt template edits. also pin the golden_prompt fixture used by the CI job to v3 so we don't get silent prompt drift.

ryan (devex): quick repro steps I used locally:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /tmp/testkey)
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r ci/requirements.txt
python ci/run_toolcall_eval.py --fixture tests/fixtures/golden_prompt_v3.json --seed 42 --no-parallel
```
If you can reproduce with --seed 42 it's likely deterministic. if it only fails intermittently, that'll point to quota or token expiry.

jordan (support): customer confirmed they were using a baked runner image with an out-of-date token and a customized eval harness that re-serializes args. they can repro locally now after updating their runner and switching to the pinned fixture.

omar (eng-ml): I pushed a quick PR that:
- adds a preflight schema sanitizer in the eval runner (coerce numeric strings, enforce booleans),
- marks toolcall tests as flaky if they hit 429/5xx on first attempt and retries 3x.
PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/inference/merge_requests/1123

ci-bot: rerun triggered: https://ci.example.com/build/8428 (rerun after PR 1123)

ci-bot: build/8428 status: flaky-failed -> retest in 5m

ops-bot: recommended customer reissue note: run `vault token create --policy=ci-runner` and update runner secret store. also recommending ephemeral short-lived tokens for CI.

jordan (support): plan: 1) customer updates token in runner per ops guidance, 2) we merge PR 1123 to reduce false negatives in eval CI, 3) add nightly schema_fuzz job and pin golden_prompt fixture. will follow up when customer confirms green.

ryan (devex): I'll open a small doc in the devex playbooks: "Reproducing toolcall schema failures in CI" with the curl snippet + the run steps above.

jordan (support): customer confirms build/8428 passed after PR + token rotation. marking as resolved from their side but leaving this thread open until we land the nightly fuzz suite and the playbook.

maya (eng): created ticket INF-2381 for the nightly schema_fuzz job and assigned to eng-ml.

omar (eng-ml): I'll follow up with a short postmortem note in the eval repo describing how the flattening change caused the type drift and the fixes we applied.

jordan (support): thanks all. closing once INF-2381 lands and playbook doc is published. :thumbsup:
